title: Lesson 4: Building a Reusable Delivery Toolkit: Skill Packaging Done Right
description: The difference between a consultant who solves one client's problem and one who compounds every engagement into the next: turning the working capture discipline, eval suite, and guardrail set from Lessons 2 and 3 into packaged, loadable skills another consultant can run without relearning them.
